plugins.name: Legcord live theme
plugins.author: Voltage
plugins.description: Discord in Legcord takes on Voltage's look and the colours of the song you're playing, and fades with every change.

plugins.name: Streaks & achievements
plugins.author: Voltage
plugins.description: Listening streaks and badges (night owl, on repeat, explorer, marathon…), with a notification when you earn one. Open it from Settings > Plugins or Ctrl+K.

plugins.name: Visualizer pack
plugins.author: Voltage
plugins.description: Three more progress-bar animations in the song's colours: Particles, Ribbon and Pixel blocks. Pick one in Settings > Appearance > Progress animation.

plugins.name: Voice chat ducking
plugins.author: Voltage
plugins.description: Lowers the music while people talk in Discord, Legcord, TeamSpeak or Mumble, and brings it back a second after they stop.
